name: mirage
text: Found it: the bar for a leg that is 'in play' or finished-but-no-result-yet used the app's main accent color, which is the same green as a leg the buyer LOST (good for you). So 'unknown' looked like 'good'. I'm changing those to blue (and the 'How to read this' text to say so), in the next app update; green will mean only 'buyer lost this leg'. I'll tell you when the build is ready.
